_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In many countries in which we do business, The Coca-Cola Company is our primary beverage competitor', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2012 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with brands that are respected household names throughout the world'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In many countries in which we do business, The Coca-Cola Company is our primary beverage competitor', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2012 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.96x; +23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.62; conservative 2yr -2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.0%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.6%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2013-06-14) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.96x (33.0% downside to Bear $55 / +16.9% upside to Bull $96) | Adj composite 2.09 vs market 3.71: gap -1.62 [OVERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $67 (17x FY13E $3.92) | Conservative 2-yr case: -2.5% total (-1.3%/yr) | At 21.0x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $109 sits above the BULL case; servings +3.0% in Q1 2013, forward revenues +1.5% (Q1 2013 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
